name: Computer and Browser Use
description: Workflow for browser-visible and computer-use tasks that need clicking, typing, screenshots, UI state inspection, approval gates, or rendered proof.

chain.step: Resolve the URL, app surface, or preview target and decide whether screenshot inspection is enough or interactive control is required.
Use web-scrape with browser:true and captureScreenshot:true for rendered inspection and visual QA.
Use user-checkpoint before high-impact UI actions, form submissions, purchases, account changes, deletes, or public deploy actions.
Use remote-cli-agent for remote Playwright/Chromium automation when the live runner owns the app or proof surface.
